role_title: Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI

must_have.requirement: B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field is required.
must_have.evidence_summary: Holds B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering from Manipal Institute of Technology (2011–2015).
must_have.positioning_bridge: Exact match to required engineering degree.

must_have.requirement: 7+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years in Product Management.
must_have.evidence_summary: 10+ years of overall professional experience (since June 2015) with 6+ years in dedicated Product Management and Senior Product Management roles at Byju's (July 2020–April 2023) and Lowe's India (Sep 2024–Present), plus earlier product prototyping and team leadership roles (2015–2020).
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly meets both total tenure and 5+ years PM requirement.

must_have.requirement: Define and drive strategy, roadmap, and execution for Product Adoption & Insights, including adoption frameworks, customer health metrics, and executive reporting.
must_have.evidence_summary: At Lowe's India, defined quarterly priorities and operational roadmaps, led KPI and dashboard development for operational decision-making, designed KPI frameworks tracking incident resolution, cost savings, platform adoption, and operational efficiency, and presented monthly business reviews and executive updates to VP/CXO stakeholders.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Highlight direct ownership of platform adoption KPI frameworks, executive reporting, and multi-quarter roadmaps at Lowe's India.

must_have.requirement: Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
must_have.evidence_summary: Translated operational, reliability, and funnel data into high-impact interventions across Lowe's (~$10M revenue protection savings, $2M asset lifecycle savings, 20% cycle time reduction) and Byju's (35% lead conversion improvement, 2.5L+ SQLs).
must_have.positioning_bridge: Demonstrate end-to-end data-to-action execution across enterprise operations and product growth.

must_have.requirement: Partner closely across Product Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to improve adoption, retention, and growth.
must_have.evidence_summary: Coordinated across engineering, product, finance, operations, IT, marketing, and executive leadership teams at Lowe's India and Byju's, driving enterprise alignment without formal authority.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Emphasize cross-functional leadership connecting engineering, business operations, GTM/sales funnels, and executive strategy.

preferred.evidence_summary: Pursuing Executive General Management Program (EGMP) at Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (2025–2026, ongoing).
preferred.positioning_bridge: Frame IIM Bangalore EGMP as executive management education equivalent in strategic scope.

preferred.requirement: Experience in Product Adoption, Product Analytics, telemetry, insights, or related data-driven products; familiarity with AI-powered recommendations or business intelligence solutions.
preferred.evidence_summary: Designed KPI frameworks tracking platform adoption, incident resolution, cost savings, and operational efficiency, built executive dashboards, and launched AI-driven procurement and automated recovery systems at Lowe's India. Does not explicitly claim standalone B2B SaaS customer-health telemetry or renewal-scoring product ownership.
preferred.positioning_bridge: Bridge internal enterprise platform adoption dashboards, operational analytics frameworks, and AI-driven workflow systems at Lowe's to Nutanix's customer adoption and AI insights charter.

implicit.requirement: Build AI-powered actionable insights and virtual agent workflows (team oversees NIVA - Nutanix Intelligent Virtual Agent) to help Customer Success and Account teams identify risks and opportunities.
implicit.evidence_summary: Designed AI-driven procurement and catalog workflows (20% cycle time reduction) and automated incident recovery workflows (~$10M annual revenue protection) at Lowe's India.
implicit.positioning_bridge: Frame Lowe's AI-assisted operational workflows and automated recovery agents as transferable foundation for building proactive AI-powered risk and adoption insights.

domain.requirement: Enterprise infrastructure / cloud / SaaS portfolio operations and value realization.
domain.evidence_summary: Operates within Reliability Engineering and Infrastructure & Operations at Lowe's India, spearheading enterprise asset lifecycle platforms ($2M savings) and infrastructure lifecycle strategies.
domain.positioning_bridge: Strong domain alignment with enterprise infrastructure operations, platform adoption, and value realization.
